The 2026-10-20 morning failure came from the rv1 dev venv: its editable vllm resolves to /root/vllm-workspace/.stack/core-prev (newer source) which imports triton.experimental.gluon, while that venv cannot provide it. The serving python imports vllm from /vllm-workspace/vllm (0.28 build) and its triton without hitting this import, so it is an environment/source-generation mismatch in the offline venv, not a defect of the serving stack or the plugin.
